_comment: Authoritative Spanish-dub-numbering -> aired-episode-numbering maps, per Sonarr seriesId. Built 2026-09-09 from TheTVDB's own public 'Alternate DVD Order' pages (no login/API key needed -- https://thetvdb.com/series/<slug>/allseasons/altdvd vs .../allseasons/official), after confirming the Spanish source library's own NxNN numbering (and its bundled 'Title1 + Title2' filenames) matches TVDB's documented DVD order exactly, not aired/broadcast order. Verified by matching titles at every DVD entry across every season before trusting this. NOT assumed to generalize to other shows automatically -- a series with no entry here has no authoritative map and the matcher says so rather than guessing or falling back to translation.

3._comment: Courage the Cowardly Dog. Seasons 1-3: clean 2-aired-episodes-per-DVD-episode pairing (DVD N = aired 2N-1, 2N). Season 2's last DVD entry (13) is a single episode because season 2 has an odd 25 aired episodes (trailing odd-one-out). Season 4 is the real irregular case: 25 aired episodes but the singleton ('The Mask') sits in the MIDDLE at DVD07, not at the end -- everything after it is shifted by one. This is exactly why '4x07' never found a clean match under the old translation/fuzzy approach.
